introduction: The adversarial PRD review gains the triage and convergence rules of EGM. Every finding is answered one of four ways instead of two: fixed, contested, escalated or declined. A contest must show counter-evidence the run can find; an escalation takes a provisional decision, writes it into the PRD and hands the question to the caller; a decline gives a reason and is refused for the findings that must not be deferred. The rounds stop once two consecutive rounds raise nothing serious. The reviewer also checks the PRD against the project's steering directives, and a contradiction is a finding that cannot be declined. The record in the envelope changes with the vocabulary.

glossary.clean round: A round whose review raised no critical and no major finding. A round whose review raised only minor findings is clean, and so is one whose review raised none at all.
glossary.counter-evidence: What a contested answer must carry so that the run can check it rather than take the reviser's word: either a quote that appears in the PRD or the input verbatim, whitespace aside, or a repository path that exists, with what it shows.
glossary.escalation: A finding the reviser answers escalated: it holds, and remedying it takes a decision the input, the steering and the code do not make — a trade-off a person should own.
glossary.provisional decision: The option an escalation takes so that the package stays complete rather than carrying an open choice: written into the PRD under its Design Decisions section opening with the word Provisional, and handed to the caller as an open question.
glossary.rubric: The written standard a finding applies, named in a field of the finding. For the PRD review it is prd, the PRD's own flaws, or steering, a contradiction of a project directive. The reviewer sets it and the reviser cannot change it.

requirements.title: The four dispositions
requirements.rationale: One word for refuting a reviewer, for deferring work and for a decision a person should own tells a reader of the record none of the three apart.

criteria.action: for any round, answer every finding of that round with exactly one of the four dispositions fixed, contested, escalated and declined
criteria.contract: a submission that uses a disposition outside those four, or that answers a finding twice, not at all, or by an id that is not of this round, is turned back with one error naming every offending id and the four values, and nothing is recorded

criteria.condition: a revision answers at least one finding fixed and leaves the PRD as it was
criteria.action: turn the revision back, saying that answering a finding fixed means changing the PRD to remedy it
criteria.contract: the submission is refused when the body, the open questions, the relevant files and the codebase notes are all the PRD's as it was; nothing is recorded; a revision that answers no finding fixed may leave the PRD as it was

criteria.condition: a contested answer carries no counter-evidence, or counter-evidence that is neither a quote appearing in the PRD or the input verbatim, whitespace aside, nor a repository path that exists
criteria.action: turn the revision back, naming every such finding and which of the two it failed
criteria.contract: one error naming each offending id and saying for each whether the quote was not found in the PRD or the input, or the path does not exist under the repository; nothing is recorded; a path that resolves outside the repository counts as not existing

criteria.condition: a declined answer gives no reason
criteria.action: turn the revision back, naming every such finding
criteria.contract: one error naming each offending id and saying that a decline must say the finding is outside this package's scope or name the later package that carries it; nothing is recorded

criteria.condition: a critical finding, or a finding whose rubric is steering, is answered declined
criteria.action: turn the revision back, naming every such finding and why it cannot be declined
criteria.contract: one error naming each offending id with its severity or its rubric, and saying that such a finding is fixed, contested or escalated; nothing is recorded

criteria.action: for any round, leave every finding's severity and rubric as the reviewer submitted them
criteria.contract: the revision's contract has no field for either, so a reviser has nowhere to put them, and every finding of the record carries the severity and the rubric the review phase gave it

criteria.condition: a round's revision does not finish, through a budget, a turn limit, a timeout, or a model or API error
criteria.action: mark every finding of that round unanswered
criteria.contract: each finding of that round carries the disposition unanswered and none of the answer fields; the findings of the rounds before it keep the answers they had

requirements.title: An escalation takes a provisional decision and hands the question on
requirements.rationale: A run nobody is watching cannot ask, and a question it neither answers nor passes on is a hole in the package.

criteria.condition: an escalated answer has no question, has fewer than two or more than three options, has no decision, or has no reason the reviser is unsure of it
criteria.action: turn the revision back, naming every such finding and the fields it is missing
criteria.contract: one error naming each offending id with the fields missing, and saying an escalation carries a question, two or three options each in one sentence, the decision taken and the reason it is uncertain; nothing is recorded

criteria.condition: an escalated answer's decision does not appear in the revised PRD body, whitespace aside
criteria.action: turn the revision back, naming every such finding and saying the decision must be written into the PRD
criteria.contract: one error naming each offending id and saying the decision belongs under the PRD's Design Decisions section, opening with the word Provisional; nothing is recorded

criteria.condition: the rounds of a PRD stop and at least one finding of any round was escalated
criteria.action: add every escalation to the open questions of the package generated from that PRD, as the question, the decision taken and the reason the reviser was unsure
criteria.contract: one open question per escalation, in round order and then in the order the reviser answered them, skipping one whose question already appears among the open questions whitespace aside; they are added after the rounds have stopped, so a later round's revision replacing the open questions cannot drop an earlier round's escalation; the result's open questions hold them and the run's summary counts them

requirements.title: Repeats across rounds
requirements.rationale: A reviewer that may raise the same finding every round turns the round limit into the only thing that stops it.

criteria.condition: a round after the first is reviewed
criteria.action: hand the review phase every finding of the earlier rounds with its disposition and the answer that disposition carries
criteria.contract: the prompt holds, for each earlier finding, its id, severity, rubric, section, flaw, evidence, remedy, any reopens id, its disposition, and the fields that disposition has: the reason and the counter-evidence of a contest, the question, options, decision and reason of an escalation, and the reason of a decline

criteria.condition: a review raises a finding whose section and flaw repeat those of a contested finding of an earlier round, whitespace aside
criteria.action: accept it only when it names that finding in its reopens field and its evidence is not the evidence the contest answered
criteria.contract: a repeat without a reopens id, and a reopen whose evidence is the one the contest already answered whitespace aside, are turned back with one error naming the earlier finding's id; a reopen with evidence the contest did not answer is accepted and recorded with that reopens id

criteria.condition: a review raises a finding whose section and flaw repeat those of a declined or an escalated finding of an earlier round, whitespace aside
criteria.action: turn the review back, naming the earlier finding and its disposition, whether or not the new finding names it in its reopens field
criteria.contract: one error naming each offending position, the earlier id and its disposition, and saying such a finding cannot be raised again; nothing is recorded

criteria.action: for any round, accept a reopens id only when it names a contested finding of an earlier round of this same review
criteria.contract: a reopens id in round 1, one that names no earlier finding of this PRD, and one that names a finding that was fixed, declined, escalated or unanswered are each turned back with one error naming the id and what is wrong; a PRD whose flaw an earlier round fixed and which still has it is raised as a new finding with no reopens id

requirements.title: When the rounds stop
requirements.rationale: One clean review is a single sample, and the cost of a second is the price of believing the first.

criteria.action: for any round, treat it as clean exactly when its review raised no critical and no major finding
criteria.contract: a round whose review raised only minor findings is clean; a round whose review raised none is clean; a round whose review raised one or more critical or major findings is not

criteria.condition: two consecutive rounds of a PRD were clean
criteria.action: stop the rounds and record that they converged
criteria.contract: the stop reason is converged; no further round is started even when the round limit allows one; the rounds run count is the number of rounds started

criteria.condition: the allowed rounds have all run and no two consecutive rounds were clean
criteria.action: stop the rounds and record that they were exhausted
criteria.contract: the stop reason is rounds_exhausted; the rounds run count equals the round limit

criteria.condition: a review or a revision does not finish, or the total budget is spent before one is started
criteria.action: stop the rounds and record that they are incomplete, whatever else held
criteria.contract: the stop reason is incomplete even where the rounds would otherwise have converged — a round whose review was clean after a clean round, whose revision then failed — and even where the limit had been reached; the package is generated from the last complete PRD; a high warning names the scope, the round, the phase that failed and why; the run's exit code is unchanged by it

criteria.condition: a review raises at least one finding and none of them is critical or major
criteria.action: run the revision of that round all the same, and go on to the next round unless the stopping rule says otherwise
criteria.contract: the round has a revision, each of its minor findings carries an answer, and the round is recorded clean; the rounds stop at it only when the round before it was also clean or the limit is reached

criteria.condition: a review raises no finding at all
criteria.action: record the round clean, run no revision for it, and apply the stopping rule
criteria.contract: the round carries an empty finding list and is clean; no revision phase is started for it, so none is billed; two such rounds in a row stop the rounds as converged

criteria.condition: the round limit is 1, the default when the rounds flag is not given
criteria.action: run one review and at most one revision, and never record that the rounds converged
criteria.contract: the stop reason is rounds_exhausted or incomplete and never converged; the phases run and the cost are the ones a single round costs today

requirements.title: The record of the review
requirements.rationale: A caller reads the record to learn what was found and what became of it, and a total that disagrees with the rounds makes it useless.

criteria.action: for any review, record on each round whether it was clean
criteria.contract: each round of the record carries a boolean saying so, true exactly when 17-REQ-4.1 holds for it

criteria.action: for any review, record each finding's rubric
criteria.contract: every finding of a PRD review carries a rubric of prd or steering, and no other value is recorded

criteria.action: for any finding, record the reviser's answer and only the fields that answer has
criteria.contract: a fixed finding carries its disposition and none of the answer fields; a contested one carries a reason and counter-evidence; an escalated one carries a question, two or three options, a decision and a reason; a declined one carries a reason; an unanswered one carries none of them

criteria.action: for any review, derive the six totals from the rounds rather than counting them as the rounds run
criteria.contract: the record carries a findings count and one count each for fixed, contested, escalated, declined and unanswered; the findings count equals the number of findings over every round and equals the sum of the other five

criteria.action: for any review, record exactly one of the three stop reasons converged, rounds_exhausted and incomplete
criteria.contract: the stop reason is one of those three and never another value, for every path through the rounds, a run with no round started included

criteria.action: for any result, carry none of the vocabulary this change replaces
criteria.contract: no result of any run carries a disposition of accepted or rejected, an accepted or rejected count, or a stop reason of no_findings or no_serious_findings, and the JSON of a reviewed package holds none of those keys or values

criteria.condition: a run reviewed at least one PRD
criteria.action: name in the summary sentence the rounds run, the findings raised with the steering ones counted apart, and the number fixed
criteria.contract: the clause reads for example review: 2 rounds, 9 findings (1 steering), 7 fixed, counted over every package of a split; the parenthesis is left out when no finding carried the steering rubric, and the clause is absent when no PRD was reviewed

requirements.title: Steering alignment in the PRD review
requirements.rationale: The steering holds what the project has decided for every package, and a PRD that contradicts a directive is reported by nothing today.

criteria.condition: a PRD is reviewed and the spec root's steering body says something
criteria.action: check the PRD against every directive of it and raise a contradiction as a finding whose rubric is steering
criteria.contract: the review's contract takes a rubric on every finding, the prompt carries the directives and the instruction to check against them, and such a finding is recorded with the rubric steering

criteria.condition: a finding whose rubric is steering has evidence that quotes no passage appearing in the steering body verbatim, whitespace aside
criteria.action: turn the review back, naming every such finding
criteria.contract: one error naming each offending position and saying the evidence of a steering finding must quote the directive it contradicts; nothing is recorded

criteria.condition: a finding whose rubric is steering is submitted with the severity minor
criteria.action: turn the review back, naming every such finding
criteria.contract: one error naming each offending position and saying a steering finding is critical or major; nothing is recorded

criteria.condition: the spec root's steering body says nothing, or the run was not asked to review the PRD
criteria.action: check no alignment and raise no finding under that rubric
criteria.contract: no finding of any round carries the rubric steering; without the review flag no round runs at all and the record is absent; the prompts are the ones built without a steering block

criteria.action: for any finding of a PRD review that is not a contradiction of a directive, set its rubric to prd
criteria.contract: every finding carries a rubric of prd or steering, and a finding submitted with any other value turns the review back with one error naming the position and the two values

execution_paths.title: Two consecutive clean rounds converge before the limit is reached

steps.action: runs spec with the adversarial review and a round limit of 3 on an input whose PRD has one serious flaw
raises one major finding in round 1
answers it fixed and submits the revised PRD
records round 1 as not clean and starts round 2
raises one minor finding in round 2
answers it fixed and submits again
records round 2 clean, and since round 1 was not, starts round 3
raises nothing in round 3
records round 3 clean, stops the rounds as converged, and runs no revision for it
reports the record with its six totals and the summary clause naming 3 rounds, 2 findings and 2 fixed

execution_paths.title: A finding is escalated, decided provisionally, and the question reaches the caller

steps.action: runs spec with the adversarial review on an input that leaves a trade-off the code and the steering do not settle
raises a major finding on the trade-off

answers it escalated with the question, three options, the decision taken and the reason it is unsure, and writes the decision under the PRD's Design Decisions section opening with the word Provisional
accepts the revision, the decision appearing in the revised body, and records the escalation
adds the escalation to the open questions of the package it writes, after the rounds have stopped
reads the question, the decision and the reason in the result's open questions, and the provisional entry in the written prd.md

execution_paths.title: A steering contradiction is reported and cannot be declined

steps.action: runs spec with the adversarial review against a spec root whose steering forbids something the input asks for
quotes the directive and raises a major finding whose rubric is steering
answers it declined with a reason, and is turned back with the finding named and told such a finding cannot be declined
answers it escalated instead, with the question, the options, the provisional decision and the reason, and submits the revised PRD
records the finding with the rubric steering and the escalation as its answer
reports the summary clause counting the steering finding apart, and the question in the result's open questions
